notes: A 42-inch Husqvarna lawn tractor with a Briggs & Stratton Intek engine and a Tuff Torq hydrostatic transmission. Husqvarna's US page lists the YTH18542 under several SKUs; the engine and transmission are shown for SKU 960 43 01-72, and the ratings in the manual are for the YTH18542 itself.

gaps: Husqvarna's illustrated parts list could not be opened by the researcher (certificate error on cms.husqvarna.com), so no belt, blade, transmission or starter part numbers are claimed.
The pages read give no engine model number or horsepower.
The manual's battery table gives no voltage; 12 V comes from its statement that the tractor has a 12 volt system (p.23).
The manual does not say what type of headlight bulb is fitted, so no bulb type is claimed.
The manual's 5 A headlight figure is in the alternator claim only.
The product page's SKU list (960430172, 960430184, 960430256, 960450060) is not matched to the manual by part number.
No production years found; years left out.
method: Operator's manual for the YTH18542 (Husqvarna PDF, form 114 25 66-32): specs p.4, controls p.8, operator presence switch p.10, V-belts p.16, belt replacement p.22, 12 volt system p.23, headlight bulb and fuse p.24. PDF page numbers equal printed ones.
Husqvarna US support page for the YTH18542: engine brand, engine name, displacement, cylinders.
Husqvarna US product page for SKU 960 43 01-72 (YTH18542): transmission brand and type; engine rows as on the support page.
Retailer parts pages (Sears PartsDirect, AppliancePartsPros) were not opened, so none of their part numbers are used.

comps.spec: Briggs & Stratton Intek engine, 32.9 cu in displacement, one cylinder, gasoline
Battery rated 28 Ah and minimum 230 CCA, case size U1R (manual p.4); the manual says the tractor has a 12 volt system (p.23)
Charging system: 3 A to the battery and 5 A to the headlights (manual p.4)

Mower blade drive belt and motion drive belt (the motion belt runs over the engine pulley and the transmission input pulley, with stationary, clutching and centerspan idlers); the manual says the belts are not adjustable and are replaced if they slip (p.16, p.22)
Engine oil SAE 30 above 32 F (0 C) or SAE 5W-30 below, API SJ-SN; 48 oz (1.4 L) with filter, 44 oz (1.3 L) without (manual p.4)
Operator presence sensing switch, ignition switch and light switch for the headlights (manual p.8, p.10)
Headlights: the bulb holder pulls out of a hole in the back of the grille, and a headlight wire connector unsnaps to remove the hood and grille assembly (manual p.24)
Fuel tank, 2.5 gal (9.46 L), unleaded regular gasoline (manual p.4)
20 A automotive-type plug-in fuse; the fuse holder is behind the dash (manual p.24)
